gloss: likeness (of a face); portrait; facial resemblance

definitions.gloss: likeness (of a face); portrait; facial resemblance
definitions.explanation: Most commonly encountered in the compound 似顔絵 (caricature/portrait sketch).

examples.japanese: {似顔絵|にがおえ}を{描|か}いてもらった。
examples.english: I had a portrait sketch drawn of me.

examples.japanese: {駅前|えきまえ}で{似顔絵|にがおえ}{師|し}が{絵|え}を{描|か}いている。
examples.english: A portrait artist is drawing pictures in front of the station.

examples.japanese: {犯人|はんにん}の{似顔絵|にがおえ}が{公開|こうかい}された。
examples.english: A composite sketch of the suspect was released.

notes:
Combines {似|に} (resemblance) and {顔|がお} (face). Almost always appears in the compound {似顔絵|にがおえ} (portrait sketch/caricature). {似顔絵|にがおえ} can refer to both artistic portrait sketches drawn at tourist spots and festivals, and police composite sketches of suspects.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {似顔絵|にがおえ}: portrait sketch, caricature
- {似顔絵|にがおえ}{師|し}: portrait artist
- {似顔絵|にがおえ}を{描|か}く: to draw a portrait sketch
- {犯人|はんにん}の{似顔絵|にがおえ}: composite sketch of a suspect

CULTURAL NOTE:
{似顔絵|にがおえ} artists are a common sight at Japanese tourist spots, festivals, and amusement parks. The style often leans toward caricature, exaggerating distinctive facial features.
